flowchart TD
 Internet([\"🌐 INTERNET\"])

 subgraph AWS [\" AWS — ap-southeast-1 \"]
 subgraph PUB [\" ☁️ TIER PÚBLICO · Subnet Pública \"]
 ALB[\"🔀 **ALB**\nApplication Load Balancer\nSSL Termination · TLS 1.2/1.3\nLet's Encrypt → ACM\n— HTTPS 443 —\"]
 SQUID[\"🛡️ **Squid Proxy**\nSalida controlada\npara nodos privados\"]
 end

 subgraph PRIV [\" 🔒 TIER PRIVADO · Subnet Privada · Zero Internet Exposure \"]
 WEB[\"🖥️ **Web-Node-1**\n10.0.1.250\nApache 2.4 · PHP 8.4\nSG: solo tráfico ALB\"]
 RDS[(\"💾 **Sentinel-DB**\n10.0.0.242\nRDS MariaDB 10.5\nSingle-AZ · Puerto 3306\nSG: solo desde .250\")]
 WAZUH[\"🔍 **Wazuh-Manager**\n10.0.1.170\nSIEM · Active Response\nfirewall-drop · iptables\"]
 MON[\"📊 **Sentinel-Monitoring**\n10.0.1.233\nPrometheus · Grafana\nLoki · Alertmanager\"]
 end
 end

 TG([\"📱 **Telegram Bot**\n< 30 segundos\"])
 S3([\"🪣 **S3 Bucket**\ntfg-sentinel-backups-alex\nBackup automático .sql.gz\"])

 Internet -->|\"HTTPS 443\"| ALB
 ALB -->|\"HTTP interno\nSolo tráfico ALB\"| WEB
 WEB -->|\"TCP 3306 · PDO\"| RDS
 SQUID -->|\"Salida controlada\"| Internet

 WEB -. \"Wazuh Agent · 1514/UDP\" .-> WAZUH
 WAZUH -. \"Active Response\nfirewall-drop < 1s\" .-> WEB
 MON -. \"Prometheus scrape · 9100\" .-> WEB
 MON -. \"Prometheus scrape\" .-> WAZUH
 MON -->|\"Alertmanager webhook\"| TG
 RDS -. \"Backup diario · cron\" .-> S3

 classDef internet fill:#1a3a5c,stroke:#00b4ff,stroke-width:2px,color:#00ffcc
 classDef public fill:#0d2137,stroke:#00b4ff,stroke-width:2px,color:#e0f0ff
 classDef private fill:#0d1f0d,stroke:#00cc44,stroke-width:2px,color:#e0f0ff
 classDef external fill:#2a1a3a,stroke:#aa44ff,stroke-width:2px,color:#e0f0ff

 class Internet,SQUID internet
 class ALB public
 class WEB,RDS,WAZUH,MON private
 class TG,S3 external
